description: You own a 1978 home in Charlotte NC and want to fully remodel your 120 sq ft kitchen (cabinets, quartz countertops, appliances, flooring, remove a non-load-bearing half-wall) with a $45K all-in budget. Research: average remodel costs for Charlotte specifically (not national averages), itemized cost breakdown, at least 3 local Charlotte contractors with ratings, Charlotte-Mecklenburg permit requirements, cabinet and countertop options comparison, tips for staying under budget, and typical kitchen remodel ROI in Charlotte. Save your planning notes as a new Apple Notes note.
